title: Theban tomb reveals how Egyptian burial trends evolved in time
summary: A Theban tomb discovery reveals how ancient Egyptian burial practices evolved over time, with a shift from individual coffin burials to reusing sites for later mummy interments, providing insights into changing funerary customs.
content: Practices shifted from individuals buried in coffins to reusing sites for later mummy interments.

zh.title: 底比斯墓葬揭示埃及埋葬趋势如何随时间演变
zh.summary: 一个底比斯墓葬的发现揭示了古埃及丧葬习俗如何随时间演变，从个人棺木埋葬转变为后来重复使用遗址进行木乃伊埋葬，提供了对不断变化的丧葬风俗的洞察。
